provider_approval_type: approved curriculum by the Department of Human Services
applicable_to: hotel and motel establishments under 2017 North American Industry Classification System codes 721110 and 721120
restaurants primarily engaged in selling ready-to-eat food for immediate consumption comprising at least 51% of total sales (excluding liquor)
truck stops providing services to the trucking industry
required_topics: identifying individuals most at risk for human trafficking
distinguishing labor from sex trafficking relevant to lodging, restaurants, and truck stops
law_references: Human trafficking recognition training curriculum by the Department of Human Services
notes: Training must be completed within six months of employment and is mandatory by June 1, 2020.
Employers can use their own or a third-party program, but they must adhere to the approved curriculum.
